Always wanted to learn to sing but not sure where to start? 

I’m running a small 3-month online beginner singing course for adults— perfect if you’d love to develop your voice, build confidence and understand how to sing with better technique, all from the comfort of your own home. 

Over 12 weekly sessions, we’ll work on: 

Breathing & posture
Pitch & vocal technique
Range & resonance
Registers & rhythm
Articulation & phrasing
Musical expression & confidence 

The sessions are friendly, supportive and completely beginner-friendly. No previous singing experience is needed.

TIKTOK LIVE PRESENTERS WANTED – START ASAP 🎥

Swiss Peak is a health & wellness brand based in Huyton, Liverpool, and we’re looking for two confident, energetic Live Presenters to join our team.

You’ll be hosting our live shopping sessions, showcasing our products, chatting with viewers and creating an exciting, engaging atmosphere that keeps people watching and buying.

THE ROLE
We currently have two presenter slots available:
Morning Presenter – 4 hours per day
Afternoon Presenter – 4 hours per day
Monday–Friday | Based in Huyton, Liverpool
We’re ideally looking for presenters who can commit to a regular weekday slot and become a familiar face of Swiss Peak.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR
We want someone who is:

Bubbly, confident and naturally engaging
Comfortable speaking and selling on camera
Genuinely interested in health, wellness and supplements
Able to maintain energy and enthusiasm throughout a 4-hour live
Good at pacing themselves and keeping conversation flowing
Able to get viewers excited about products, offers and promotions
Reliable and comfortable working to a regular schedule

Energy is particularly important during major sales periods such as Black Friday and the lead-up to Christmas, when our live sessions can get especially busy.

Previous live presenting, sales, TikTok Shop, retail, hosting or content creation experience would be a big advantage, but personality and confidence are just as important to us.

PAY
£15–£20 per hour, depending on previous experience.

START DATE
ASAP
If you’re confident on camera, love speaking to people and think you could bring great energy to Swiss Peak Lives, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply with a little information about yourself, your availability and any relevant presenting, sales or content experience.

topComments.text: Highly recommend Katy McKenna who's commented. Happy to provide references for her.

**STOP IMAGINING SOUND. START BUILDING YOUR INSTRUMENT.**

*Online Vocal Coaching Based Purely on Vocal Physiology & Physics*

Welcome to the **Vocal Gym**.

Mirella Freni's student

Guildhall School of Music and Drama graduate

Lunenburg Academy of Music Performance Artist in Residence

Most traditional coaching relies on vague visualizations and acoustic myths (*"sing in the mask"*, *"feel the sound between your eyes"*). Your voice is not a metaphor - it is a biological, physical instrument governed by muscle isolation, air pressure, and pharyngeal geometry.

Whether you are an amateur building your voice from scratch or a working professional struggling with vocal fatigue, real progress comes from concrete biomechanics:

* **Targeted Muscle Isolation:** Isolate and balance the TA (*Thyroarytenoid*) and CT (*Cricothyroid*) muscles to build genuine core power, register balance, and flexibility without strain.
* **Pharyngeal Geometry & Real Projection:** Utilize the pharyngeal resonator and *Squillo* for projection that cuts through any mix - without forcing air or spreading into a smile.
* **Zero Interference:** Eliminate throat constriction, hyoid tension, and tongue root interference at the physical source.
**WHO IS THIS FOR?**
* **Amateurs:** Build a rock-solid, healthy physiological foundation right from day one with zero fluff.
* **Professionals:** Fix stamina issues, expand your dynamic range, unlock effortless *Appoggio*, and gain 100% predictable control over your instrument.

🎁 **FREE 1st ONLINE CONSULTATION**

*30-Minute Biomechanical Vocal Audit & Diagnostic Session*

We’ll analyze your current vocal setup, pinpoint physical blockages, and lay out a clear, objective training roadmap.

📍 **Format:** 1-on-1 Online

📩 **How to book:** Send a DM now to claim your free diagnostic session. Space is limited!

CASTING CALL | DORTMUND | No-Budget-Kurzfilm (Thriller/Horror)
Für unseren atmosphärischen Indie-Kurzfilm Haunted Guilt (das Debüt-Projekt von Umbra Refugium Films) suchen wir im Raum Dortmund noch markante Darsteller für zwei prägende Rollen.

⚠️ Wichtiger Hinweis: Es handelt sich hierbei um eine unabhängige No-Budget-Produktion. Wir suchen passionierte Schauspieler, die Lust haben, ein handgemachtes, spannendes Projekt im Ruhrgebiet zum Leben zu erwecken.

Gesuchte Rollen:

WOLFGANG (Spielalter: ca. 50 + Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Markant, geheimnisvoll, getrieben. Wolfgang trägt eine innere Schwere mit sich herum, die ihn undurchschaubar und gefährlich wirken lässt. Er hat eine intensive, zurückhaltende Präsenz, die den Zuschauer ständig an seinen Absichten zweifeln lässt.

Anforderung: Gespielt wird ein Charakter mit Ecken und Kanten, der eine zentrale, bedrohliche Rolle in der Geschichte spielt.

OTTO (Spielalter: ca. 45+  Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Charismatisch, manipulativ, besitzergreifend. Otto ist der Kopf hinter dem Geschehen, ein Puppenspieler mit eiskaltem Verstand. Er verbirgt seine wahre Natur hinter einer freundlichen Fassade, die jedoch schnell Risse bekommt.

Anforderung: Satter schauspielerischer Ausdruck, der die psychologische Spannung und den Horror des Thrillers trägt.

Eckdaten:

Projekt: Haunted Guilt (Kurzfilm / Psychothriller)

Ort: Dortmund & Umgebung

Gagen: Unbezahltes Indie-/No-Budget-Projekt Verpflegung am Set inklusive

Drehzeitraum: 10-18 Oktober

Du hast Lust auf ein ambitioniertes, eigenständiges Projekt mit starkem visuellen Look und möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden?

Schreib uns gerne eine Nachricht mit deinen aktuellen Sedcard-Fotos / Showreel an:

📧 philippbrendel2@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns auf eure Bewerbungen!

Anbei noch ein kurzer atmosphärischer teaser Trailer!!

CASTING CALL | DORTMUND | No-Budget-Kurzfilm (Thriller/Horror)
Für unseren atmosphärischen Indie-Kurzfilm Haunted Guilt (das Debüt-Projekt von Umbra Refugium Films) suchen wir im Raum Dortmund noch markante Darsteller für zwei prägende Rollen.

⚠️ Wichtiger Hinweis: Es handelt sich hierbei um eine unabhängige No-Budget-Produktion. Wir suchen passionierte Schauspieler, die Lust haben, ein handgemachtes, spannendes Projekt im Ruhrgebiet zum Leben zu erwecken.

Gesuchte Rollen:

WOLFGANG (Spielalter: ca. 50 + Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Markant, geheimnisvoll, getrieben. Wolfgang trägt eine innere Schwere mit sich herum, die ihn undurchschaubar und gefährlich wirken lässt. Er hat eine intensive, zurückhaltende Präsenz, die den Zuschauer ständig an seinen Absichten zweifeln lässt.

Anforderung: Gespielt wird ein Charakter mit Ecken und Kanten, der eine zentrale, bedrohliche Rolle in der Geschichte spielt.

OTTO (Spielalter: ca. 45+  Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Charismatisch, manipulativ, besitzergreifend. Otto ist der Kopf hinter dem Geschehen, ein Puppenspieler mit eiskaltem Verstand. Er verbirgt seine wahre Natur hinter einer freundlichen Fassade, die jedoch schnell Risse bekommt.

Anforderung: Satter schauspielerischer Ausdruck, der die psychologische Spannung und den Horror des Thrillers trägt.

Eckdaten:

Projekt: Haunted Guilt (Kurzfilm / Psychothriller)

Ort: Dortmund & Umgebung

Gagen: Unbezahltes Indie-/No-Budget-Projekt Verpflegung am Set inklusive

Drehzeitraum: 10-18 Oktober

Du hast Lust auf ein ambitioniertes, eigenständiges Projekt mit starkem visuellen Look und möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden?

Schreib uns gerne eine Nachricht mit deinen aktuellen Sedcard-Fotos / Showreel an:

📧 philippbrendel2@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns auf eure Bewerbungen!

Anbei noch ein kurzer atmosphärischer teaser Trailer!!

**Budujemy czułą, twórczą społeczność na Mokotowie!**

Czuła Fundacja Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie

Akademia Sceny wystartowała! Mamy jeszcze miejsca w grupie! Może czakamy właśnie na Ciebie?

Poznaj nas! Jesteśmy duetem twórczym. Działamy od wielu lat. Z zawodu Jesteśmy aktorami. Postanowiliśmy zbudować własną przestrzeń. W poszanowaniu dla granic. Bez przemocy i presji. Tworzymy własny teatr - profesjonalne spektakle. Prowadzimy też warsztaty artystyczne. Zapraszamy Cię do naszej Akademii Sceny. Spotykamy się w gronie dorosłych i młodzieży. Uczymy profesjonalnego teatru. Tworzymy spektakle. Wymieniamy doświadczenia. Odpoczywamy. Działamy w poczuciu bezpieczeństwa i z dbałością o dobrostan emocjonalny. Dołącz do drużyny Czułego Teatru!

Spotykamy się w środy o 17.30 w FORMA Ośrodek Kultury. 

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się o nas więcej, odwiedź stronę internetową:

https://www.czulafundacja.pl/akademia-sceny

Możesz też do nas napisać na: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl

Albo przyjść na zajęcia w najbliższą środę!

ZAPRASZAMY!

**STOP IMAGINING SOUND. START BUILDING YOUR INSTRUMENT.**

*Online Vocal Coaching Based Purely on Vocal Physiology & Physics*

Welcome to the **Vocal Gym**.

Mirella Freni's student

Guildhall School of Music and Drama graduate

Lunenburg Academy of Music Performance Artist in Residence

Most traditional coaching relies on vague visualizations and acoustic myths (*"sing in the mask"*, *"feel the sound between your eyes"*). Your voice is not a metaphor - it is a biological, physical instrument governed by muscle isolation, air pressure, and pharyngeal geometry.

Whether you are an amateur building your voice from scratch or a working professional struggling with vocal fatigue, real progress comes from concrete biomechanics:

* **Targeted Muscle Isolation:** Isolate and balance the TA (*Thyroarytenoid*) and CT (*Cricothyroid*) muscles to build genuine core power, register balance, and flexibility without strain.
* **Pharyngeal Geometry & Real Projection:** Utilize the pharyngeal resonator and *Squillo* for projection that cuts through any mix - without forcing air or spreading into a smile.
* **Zero Interference:** Eliminate throat constriction, hyoid tension, and tongue root interference at the physical source.
**WHO IS THIS FOR?**
* **Amateurs:** Build a rock-solid, healthy physiological foundation right from day one with zero fluff.
* **Professionals:** Fix stamina issues, expand your dynamic range, unlock effortless *Appoggio*, and gain 100% predictable control over your instrument.

🎁 **FREE 1st ONLINE CONSULTATION**

*30-Minute Biomechanical Vocal Audit & Diagnostic Session*

We’ll analyze your current vocal setup, pinpoint physical blockages, and lay out a clear, objective training roadmap.

📍 **Format:** 1-on-1 Online

📩 **How to book:** Send a DM now to claim your free diagnostic session. Space is limited!

👧 Dziewczyna: 15–18 lat

Szukamy naturalnych, swobodnych przed kamerą osób zainteresowanych udziałem w produkcji filmowej. Doświadczenie aktorskie nie jest wymagane.

CASTING CALL! 🎬

I'm a BFA Narrative Film student at the University of Central Florida. I am writing & directing a short film titled "The Scam."

Unpaid/Non-Union

IMDb credit, footage, meals and snacks provided!

Looking to fill three lead roles:

Betty - Female, 70s, a gullible grandmother, riddled with debt, falls for a phone call scam and is desperate to believe the scammer, wanting his promises to be true. LEAD

Holly - Female, 40s-50s, Betty’s daughter, sick and tired of Betty falling for scams and frivolously spending her money, forcefully tries to stop her mother from falling for yet another scam. LEAD

Diane - Female, 20s, Betty’s kind-hearted granddaughter, trying to take a gentler approach to reasoning with her grandmother. Uses logic and softer tones of voice to try and explain to Betty what she is falling for. 

The shootings dates will be 2-3 days over a weekend or two in Spring 2027. Filming will take place in Orlando, Florida. 

If you are interested in submitting a self-tape, send headshots, resume and/or reels, and what role you would like to audition for to rachelremenyfilms@gmail.com for more information! Thank you!!

🎩🕵️ Geheimagent für außergewöhnliche Geburtstagsmission gesucht! 🕵️🎩
Für den 9. Geburtstag meines Sohnes suchen wir eine kreative Person mit schauspielerischem Talent, die Lust hat, Teil eines ganz besonderen Agenten-Abenteuers zu werden.

📅 Wann:

Idealerweise am 31.10. (alternativ 01.11./ 07.11 / 08.11)

📍 Wo:

Unterschleißheim bei München

⏱ Dauer:

Ca. 2 Stunden

👦 Teilnehmer:

Etwa 6 bis 10 Kinder im Alter von 9 bis 11 Jahren.

Die Idee:

Zu Beginn der Feier klingelt ein vermeintlicher Geheimagent an der Tür. Er erscheint in passender Agentenkleidung und sollte auf die Kinder möglichst authentisch und glaubwürdig wirken. Die Kinder sollen wirklich das Gefühl haben, dass ein echter Agent ihre Hilfe benötigt.

Er erzählt, dass er einen gefährlichen Täter verfolgt und dringend Unterstützung bei den Ermittlungen braucht. Gemeinsam mit den Kindern geht er auf Spurensuche, sammelt Beweise, untersucht Hinweise und löst Rätsel.

Wir stellen uns dabei Aktivitäten wie beispielsweise Fingerabdruckanalysen, das Entschlüsseln geheimer Botschaften, versteckte Hinweise, geheime Dokumente, Codes, UV-Hinweise, Tatortspuren oder ähnliche Agenten- und Detektivaufgaben vor. Hier würden wir uns auch über eigene kreative Ideen und Erfahrungen freuen.

Der große Plot-Twist:

Im Laufe der Ermittlungen verdichten sich die Hinweise immer mehr. Am Ende führen alle Spuren zu einem Safe oder einem geheimen Versteck. Dort finden die Kinder schließlich ein Foto des Täters und erkennen überrascht, dass es sich um den Geheimagenten handelt, der sie durch die gesamte Mission begleitet hat.

In diesem Moment wird jedoch die Wahrheit aufgedeckt: Die Agentur wusste bereits von seinem Verrat und hat die Kinder bewusst in die Ermittlungen eingebunden, um seine Tarnung zu entlarven. Die Kinder haben erfolgreich den Fall gelöst und den Täter überführt.

Zum Abschluss werden sie offiziell für ihren Einsatz geehrt und als Nachwuchsagenten ausgezeichnet.

Wichtig:

Wir suchen keine klassische Kinderanimation, sondern jemanden, der die Rolle überzeugend spielen kann und Freude an Improvisation und Storytelling hat. Die Kinder sollen für etwa zwei Stunden vollständig in die Geschichte eintauchen können. Ziel ist ein Erlebnis, das sich möglichst wie ein spannender Agentenfilm anfühlt.

Wir haben bereits viele Ideen für Story, Rätsel und Ablauf und würden diese gerne gemeinsam weiterentwickeln.

Die Tätigkeit wird selbstverständlich angemessen vergütet.

Falls du Interesse hast oder jemanden empfehlen kannst, freuen wir uns über eine Nachricht mit ein paar Informationen zu dir sowie gerne Fotos, Referenzen oder kurzen Videos.

Vielen Dank!

Anna

Hi everyone! We are casting for an independent short film shooting in📍Bucharest, Romania in early November.

Genre: Psychological Drama / Crime Comedy

📃Synopsis:

The film follows two brothers who travel to Romania believing they are about to inherit a fortune from their supposedly dying aunt. A series of misunderstandings and increasingly disastrous decisions turns their inheritance trip into a chaotic night on the run.

🎭 JOE

Gender: male

Playing ages: 20–30

Language: English with a UK accent 

Flamboyant, confident, funny and highly verbal. Joe is intelligent and successful, but underneath his confidence is an emotionally immature younger brother who desperately wants his older brother’s approval.

He uses humour as a defence mechanism, becoming more sarcastic, energetic and ridiculous when uncomfortable or afraid.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Improvisational instincts

• Strong screen presence

• Comfortable with fast dialogue & profanity

• Ability to shift naturally between comedy, arrogance, fear and vulnerability

🎭 AUNTIE VIOLET

Gender: female

Playing ages: 65-75

Language: English with a UK accent 

A key supporting role with relatively short screen time, but an important presence in the film. 

Violet initially appears to be a wealthy, eccentric elderly woman whom the brothers believe is dying. 

She is glamorous, sharp, mischievous and intimidating, with a strong sense of control and authority.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Confident, commanding presence

• Ability to convey glamour and authority

• Ability to play sudden, realistic death

• Comfortable with profanity

Note: The final head-explosion effect will be created using a dummy/prosthetic. The actress will not be in danger.

▪️Audition: Self-tape

▪️This is an unpaid role. However, all expenses related to the project will be covered, including meals, travel from the UK or Europe.

📩 To apply: send your headshot + CV to cinedanny88@gmail.com

Please include “JOE” or “AUNTIE VIOLET” in the subject line.

📢 Feel free to share this casting call with anyone you think might be a good fit for either role. Thank you!

Flamboyant, confident, funny and highly verbal. Joe is intelligent and successful, but underneath his confidence is an emotionally immature younger brother who desperately wants his older brother’s approval.

He uses humour as a defence mechanism, becoming more sarcastic, energetic and ridiculous when uncomfortable or afraid.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Improvisational instincts

• Strong screen presence

• Comfortable with fast dialogue & profanity

• Ability to shift naturally between comedy, arrogance, fear and vulnerability

🎭 AUNTIE VIOLET

Gender: female

Playing ages: 65-75

Language: English with a UK accent 

A key supporting role with relatively short screen time, but an important presence in the film. 

Violet initially appears to be a wealthy, eccentric elderly woman whom the brothers believe is dying. 

She is glamorous, sharp, mischievous and intimidating, with a strong sense of control and authority.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Confident, commanding presence

• Ability to convey glamour and authority

• Ability to play sudden, realistic death

• Comfortable with profanity

Note: The final head-explosion effect will be created using a dummy/prosthetic. The actress will not be in danger.

▪️Audition: Self-tape

▪️This is an unpaid role. However, all expenses related to the project will be covered, including meals, travel from the UK or Europe.

📩 To apply: send your headshot + CV to cinedanny88@gmail.com

Please include “JOE” or “AUNTIE VIOLET” in the subject line.

📢 Feel free to share this casting call with anyone you think might be a good fit for either role. Thank you!

Chętnie dołączę do produkcji filmowych, reklamowych, teledysków, sesji zdjęciowych i innych projektów kreatywnych.

Mogę wesprzeć projekt m.in. w zakresie:

— visual concept & creative direction
— przygotowania koncepcji scen i ujęć od strony wizualnej
— organizacji i koordynacji kreatywnej części projektu
— współpracy z fotografami, stylistami, modelami i innymi twórcami
— tworzenia contentu i materiałów do social media

Mam doświadczenie zarówno w projektowaniu mody, jak i w pracy nad sesjami, kampaniami, contentem i projektami kreatywnymi.

Jestem otwarta zarówno na pojedyncze zlecenia, jak i współpracę przy większych produkcjach.

Hallöchen ich habe mich vor gewisser Zeit dazu entschieden eine Fortsetzung eines Buches mit der Thematik Mafia zu verfassen und diese in eine animierte Serie weiter zu verarbeiten 

Für diese Serie suche ich noch einige Leute die den Charakteren ihre Stimme schenken möchten 

Wichtig: dies ist ein Projekt was nicht veröffentlicht wird daher bitte ich beteiligte es ebenso nicht zu veröffentlichen und nachzufragen falls sie es ihren Freunden zeigen möchten

Bei Interesse gerne privat schreiben 

Optional wäre es wenn ihr discord habt damit wir da ich die App für die Kommunikation übersichtlicher finde ist dennoch kein muss

HALLOWEEN SCARE MAZE EXPERIENCE 👻    - 🎃 ACTORS WANTED!
📍 Tintwistle, Derbyshire | 30th & 31st October 2026

⭐ Great opportunity to gain live performance experience & add to your acting CV

We're looking for actors/performers to join us for our Halloween scare maze on Friday 30th and Saturday 31st October, taking place in Tintwistle, Derbyshire.

We've been running our scare experience as a family-run event for around 8 years, and every year we continue to make it bigger and better. What started out much smaller has grown into a production with detailed sets, animatronics, props, lighting, sound, strobe effects, special effects and a large cast of actors.

This year we're looking to build an even bigger cast and are looking for people who would love the chance to get involved in a proper live, immersive performance environment.

🎭 What could you be doing?

• Playing a dedicated character within the attraction

• Performing jump scares and character interactions

• Working within themed rooms and sets

• Improvising and interacting with members of the public

• Working alongside other actors to create scares

• Potentially having a character, room or jump scare specifically designed around you

This is an unpaid opportunity, and a free event with donations going towards North West Air Ambulance Charity. ❤️🚁

However, this could be a great opportunity for actors and performers looking to gain practical live performance experience, build their CV and get experience performing for a live audience in an immersive environment.

You don't need professional acting experience to get involved. We're mainly looking for people who are enthusiastic, confident, creative and willing to throw themselves into a character and have some fun with it!

👻 The earlier you get involved, the more we can create around you!

Once we know who is joining the cast, we can start planning characters, costumes, makeup, rooms and individual scares.

If we know you're coming early enough, we can potentially build a room around your character, design a jump scare specifically for you, create props for your scene and develop your character within the attraction.

So the sooner we can get our cast confirmed, the more time we have to make your part of the experience really good.

📅 Friday 30th October (6-10pm)

📅 Sat 31st October (6-10pm)

📍 Tintwistle, Derbyshire

❤️ In aid of North West Air Ambulance Charity

If you're interested, please comment below or send me a DM with a little bit about yourself, any acting/performance experience you have (if any), and which date(s) you're available for

.

We're hoping to put together a really strong cast and a massive Halloween experience this year, so if this sounds like something you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you! 🎃👻

Feel free to tag any actors/performers who might be interested!

# **LONDON** Murder Mystery Live Event Casting

Casting for an immersive murder mystery event. We're looking for 2 confident performers to play suspects across our story worlds. Prior acting experience necessary, stage presence, improvisation, and comfort performing to a live audience are a must.

**What's involved:**
* Interacting with guests in character before the show starts, including being photographed with guests
* Playing a suspect character across live show nights
* Staying in character during live audience Q&A
* Delivering scripted reveal/alibi lines with different variations per night
* 

**Schedule:** Shows run from 7:00pm to 11:00pm, with performers needed for the full window.

We're launching our first show on 17th of October, with our next run of shows from late November onwards, hosting 2 to 4 events per month.

**Pay:** £100 per show.

We're looking for the following:
* White Male with Dark Hair - 30-40 (Mysterious, Shady Character)
* White Male bald 45-60s 

Interested? Send us a short intro, a photo, and any performance/acting experience (if you have it) to team@theenquirylondon.co.uk

items.text:
🎬❤️ KAMERATEAM FÜR FILMPROJEKT „DIE HAND AUFS HERZ“ GESUCHT ❤️🎬

Ich möchte parallel zu meinem geplanten Albumrelease am 01.02.2027 einen Film produzieren und suche dafür ein engagiertes Kamerateam / Filmteam aus Wiesbaden, Mainz, Frankfurt und Umgebung, das Lust hat, gemeinsam ein besonderes Herzensprojekt umzusetzen.

🎥 Das Projekt: „Die Hand aufs Herz“

Im Mittelpunkt steht eine romantische Geschichte über Liebe, Gefühle, Vertrauen, Mitgefühl und die Frage, was im Leben wirklich zählt. Die Musik meines Albums soll dabei eng mit der Handlung des Films verbunden werden – sodass am Ende eine Kombination aus Film und Musikalbum entsteht.

❤️ Ziel ist kein gewöhnliches Musikvideo, sondern ein richtiges filmisches Projekt mit Handlung, Charakteren und emotionalen Momenten.

🎤 Über mich

Mein Name ist Marcel Freibuchner. Ich bin Musiker, Beatproduzent und Autor und komme aus dem Raum Wiesbaden.

Ich habe bereits verschiedene Erfahrungen im Medien- und Entertainmentbereich gesammelt, unter anderem als:

🎬 Darsteller bei „Krass Schule“
🎬 Mitwirkung bei „Hilf mir!“
🎬 Mitwirkung bei „Auf Streife“
📺 Protagonist bei „taff“
🎭 Rolle als Danny in einem YouTube-Projekt
🎤 DSDS Recall
🎧 Beatproduzent mit zahlreichen eigenen Produktionen
🏆 eigene Musikprojekte mit erfolgreichen Streaming-Erfahrungen

Außerdem habe ich bereits ein eigenes E-Book über das Produzieren von Musik veröffentlicht.

🎥 Wen suche ich?

Ich suche insbesondere:

📹 Kameramann/Kamerafrau
🎬 Regie
💡 Licht
🎞️ Schnitt/Postproduktion
🎥 kleines Film-/Kamerateam

Ideal wäre ein Team aus Wiesbaden, Mainz, Frankfurt oder dem Rhein-Main-Gebiet, das Interesse an einem kreativen Independent-Filmprojekt hat.

Das Projekt soll gemeinsam professionell entwickelt werden – vom Drehbuch über die Dreharbeiten bis hin zum fertigen Film.

Wenn du Kamera machst, ein Filmteam hast oder jemanden kennst, der für so ein Projekt interessant wäre, freue ich mich sehr über eine Nachricht. Gerne kann ich das Konzept und weit

items.text:
🎬 CASTING DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO
Role bez tekstu.

Zgłoszenia tylko drogą mailową

Poszukujemy aktorów/epizodystów:

Mężczyzna — 20 - 25 lat

Młody, atrakcyjny mężczyzna. Szczupła, proporcjonalna sylwetka.

Typ: miejski, nowoczesny, premium / corporate.

Zadbany, pewny siebie, ambitny.

Kobieta — 19 - lat

Młoda kobieta o charakterystycznej, naturalnej urodzie i wyrazistej twarzy. Długie ciemne włosy, szczupła sylwetka.

Typ: niezależna, współczesna, z charakterem.

Mile widziana naturalna, nieoczywista uroda i mocna osobowość.

Mężczyzna — 70–80 lat

Senior o bardzo charakterystycznej twarzy, siwych włosach i zaroście. Szczupła lub średnia sylwetka.

Szukamy osoby ciepłej, wiarygodnej i emocjonalnej, potrafiącej opowiadać historię przede wszystkim spojrzeniem i mimiką.

Naturalność i autentyczność mile widziane.

Mężczyzna — 30–40 lat

Przystojny, charakterystyczny mężczyzna o wyrazistych rysach i ciemnych włosach.

Postać pojawia się w kilku okresach: lata 60,70 i 80, dlatego ważna jest możliwość wiarygodnego pokazania upływu czasu.

Typ: charyzmatyczny, męski, ekranowy.

Kobieta — 30–40 lat

Kobieta o ciepłej, klasycznej urodzie.

Kobieca, elegancka, naturalna.

Postać również pokazujemy w różnych okresach – lata 60., 70. i 80.

Ważna umiejętność wiarygodnego przechodzenia między różnymi etapami życia i stylami epoki.

Kobieta — 40–55 lat

Ciepła, zadbana, atrakcyjna kobieta o naturalnym wyglądzie.

Typ: współczesna mama – silna, troskliwa, rodzinna.

Naturalna mimika i wiarygodność przed kamerą ważniejsze niż „modelowy” wygląd.

Mężczyzna — 45–55 lat

Zadbany, męski, naturalny mężczyzna. Krótkie ciemne włosy, możliwy lekki zarost.

Typ: spokojny, pracowity, rodzinny tata.

Szukamy naturalności, ciepła i wiarygodności, bez przesadnie „reklamowego” wizerunku.

📍 Zdjęcia w Warszawie w 2 połowie października 

📩 Zgłoszenia:

blackwolfproductionpl@gmail.com

📝 W treści zgłoszenia podaj:

• Imię i nazwisko

• Wiek

• Numer telefonu

• Zdjęcie twarzy i całej sylwetki

• Demo/real (link do YouTube)

Pozostałe szczegóły przekażemy wybranym osobom.

🎬 **CASTING – SCHAUSPIELER/IN (M/W/D) GESUCHT | HEIDELBERG **

Für einen professionellen Videodreh für unseren **Bewerbungs- und Recruitingprozess** suchen wir eine sympathische, seriöse und kamerastarke Person im Alter von **35–50 Jahren**.

**Geschlecht spielt keine Rolle – entscheidend sind Ausstrahlung, Professionalität und ein souveränes Auftreten vor der Kamera.**

📍 **Drehort:** Heidelberg-Bahnstadt, Lange Anger 38
⏱️ **Drehdauer:** ca. 3 Stunden
💰 **Gage:** 500 €
📅 **Termin:** Donnerstag oder Freitag (diese Woche) – wir sind flexibel und richten uns gerne nach dir
🎥 **Format:** Social Media / Reel-Format
👔 **Kleidung:** Business Casual

**Was wir suchen:**
• Alter ca. 35–50 Jahre
• seriöses & professionelles Auftreten
• sympathische und authentische Ausstrahlung
• gepflegtes Erscheinungsbild
• sicher und natürlich vor der Kamera
• Business-Casual-Look
• Schauspiel-/Werbeerfahrung von Vorteil

Gedreht werden mehrere kurze Videos für unseren Bewerbungsprozess. Der gesamte Dreh dauert etwa **3 Stunden** und findet bei uns vor Ort in Heidelberg statt.

📲 **BEWERBUNG DIREKT PER WHATSAPP:**
**0172 6302111**

Bitte schickt uns **ein kurzes Bewerbungsvideo**, in dem ihr euch kurz vorstellt und ein paar Sätze frei in die Kamera sprecht. Gerne zusätzlich Alter, Wohnort und – falls vorhanden – bisherige Referenzen oder Showreels mitsenden.

**Wichtig:** Bitte ausschließlich Bewerbungen mit Video, damit wir direkt einen Eindruck vom Auftreten vor der Kamera bekommen.

Wir freuen uns auf eure Bewerbung! 🎬

🔥 „FAHRENHEIT” - OPEN CASTING

Jesteś aktorem, aktorką, performerem, performerką - a może po prostu osobą z mocną sceniczną osobowością i ciekawością, by spróbować czegoś nowego?

Zapraszamy do castingu do „Fahrenheit” - nowej międzynarodowej koprodukcji Teatru im. Jana Kochanowskiego w Opolu, realizowanej we współpracy z fix+foxy, w reżyserii duńskiego reżysera Tue Bieringa.

Szukamy osób otwartych na wspólne tworzenie, eksperymentowanie, pracę na styku różnych dziedzin i wnoszenie do procesu własnej wyobraźni i energii.

Casting odbędzie się w dwóch etapach: online (formularz + krótkie wideo w języku angielskim), a następnie wybrane osoby zostaną zaproszone na drugi etap castingu na żywo w Opolu z reżyserem.

👉 Zgłoszenia online do 16 października 2026.

Szczegóły i formularz zgłoszeniowy: https://forms.gle/7D2a7U1dN8bLkHAX6 

Przyjdź. Poznajmy się. Zobaczmy, co możemy stworzyć razem. 🔥

[ENG]

🔥 FAHRENHEIT - OPEN CASTING

Are you an actor, performer, dancer, or simply someone with a strong stage presence and a curiosity to explore something new?

We invite you to audition for “Fahrenheit” - a new international theatre coproduction by JK Opole Theatre, created in collaboration with fix&foxy and directed by Danish director Tue Biering.

We are looking for people open to collaboration, experimentation, working across disciplines and bringing their own imagination and energy into the process.

The casting has two stages: online (application form + short video in English), followed by an in-person casting in Opole with the director.

👉 Applications are open until 16 October 2026.

Find full details and the application form here: https://forms.gle/7D2a7U1dN8bLkHAX6 

Come and meet us. Let’s see what we can create together. 🔥

**Mała Akademia Teatralna **Czuła Fundacja** **Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie wystartowała!

Są jeszcze ostatnie miejsca w obydwu grupach!

Podaruj swojemu dziecku bezpieczną przestrzeń do rozwoju, profesjonalnej edukacji teatralnej i eksploracji wyobraźni!

Spotykamy się we wtorki.

Z dziećmi od 7 do 9 lat - od 16.00 do 17.30.

Z dziećmi od 9 do 12 lat od 17.30 do 19.00.

w FORMA Ośrodek Kultury

Zajęcia Małej Akademii Teatralnej to profesjonalna edukacja teatralna, w poszanowaniu granic uczestników. Na moich zajęciach dzieci się wygłupiają i szaleją. Mogą zrealizować wszystkie swoje pomysły. Twarzą pełne wsparcia relacje rówieśnicze.

Pamiętam, czego mi brakowało, kiedy jako dziecko uczyłam się teatru. I właśnie to - daję teraz dzieciom.

For the directors and choreographers who think musicals are an Olympic sport…

I see you. 👀 

When you’re ready to transform your ensemble, I’ll be right here with the tools and resources you need to turn mush into muscles!

Message me for workshop details!

sharedPost.text:
I may or may not treat musical theatre like an Olympic sport. 😂

But jokes aside—if you bring me in, I’m going to raise the bar.

Not because I expect your students to already know how to dance. Because I believe they can LEARN.

At Nelson University, we started with the basics: pirouettes, pas de bourrée, chassés, pivot turns, jazz squares. We learned the skills. We drilled them. We repeated them. Then we put them together.

Was there repetition? Ohhhhh yes. 😂

But that’s the point.

Learn it. Drill it. Apply it. Get coached. Do it again.

If your students can walk—and walk on time—we have something to work with.

So directors, if you’re ready to expect more from your ensemble, I’m your girl.

Bring me in to lay the foundation, then let’s keep your students training in the background while rehearsals continue.

Give them the skills. Give them the reps. Give them the expectation.

They’ll surprise you with what they can do.

Or, as Arnold would say…we’re turning that mush into muscles. 💪😂

#TheatreEducation #MusicalTheatre #DanceTraining #TheatreTeacher #ThespiansAreAthletes InMotionStudios
Nelson Theatre

Hello everyone,
I have some very exciting news to share! 

Below, you will find the casting call for my original film series, LOOPED! I am so excited to see the amazing talent we can find to bring this story to life! We already have an incredible cast and crew assembled, and I can't wait to meet the rest of these characters in person. 

This is an unpaid opportunity to work with other passionate creatives and have your work published on various streaming platforms. We will be filming in the Limestone Coast of South Australia across towns such as Naracoorte, Mt Gambier, Millicent and Robe.

Please share to your friends and family or anyone you know who might be interested - ALL auditions are welcome!

Any queries, please feel free to send me a message or email flamingflamingostudios@gmail.com ☺️✨️

Best wishes,

Bri

items.text: Hello everyone! I'm filming several series here in Colorado, but this is probably the most fun! If you ever wanted to be a character on RENO911 now is your chance! Some of my previous clips have 1 to 3 million views! We're looking for goofy, eccentric, fun, outrageous characters! Just a headshot or a recent selfie, and a brief description of what type of character you'd like to play! These shoots take anywhere from 15 to 30 minutes to shoot, and average anywhere between 200k to sometimes 3 million views! Hope to hear from you soon!

topComments.text: What are the days and locations for the filming? I worked in law enforcement for a few years, so I know how suspects act. 😂

CASTING CALL: HORROR FEATURE FILM

'Dimas feature production'

Horror/supernatural

Logeline:
After seeking some Halloween fun, a group of teenagers enters a corn maze that promises a thrilling good time. But as they venture deeper inside, the innocent attraction quickly turns into a terrifying nightmare.

Alex Teff / 18+ to play younger
Mia's boyfriend, cool guy, mysterious, doesn't get along with the whole group, athletic, good at avoiding problems, nonchalant, a little arrogant

Brady Robbison / 18+ to play younger
comedy timing, energentic, best friend's with theo, has a secret crush on someone in the group, despare to not die, a little native.

Isabella Quinn / 18+ to play younger
brat, good common sense, no-nonsense, good style, drama queen, sensitive, pasive-agressive, hates Alex.

Production Schedule: Late october - Early November
Location: Denver, Colorado

If you are interested in auditioning, please submit your materials directly to dimasfilmsinfo@gmail.com.

Subject Line: Horror Feature - [Actor Name]
Required Materials: Headshot and resume only.
Submission Details: Please clearly state the name of the character you are interested in within your message.

items.text:
CASTING BUSINESSMEN FOR SENIOR
THESIS SHORT FILM!

Hello, my name is Elliot Harrington and I am the producer of the upcoming short film called “Sponsored By”. It is about a divorced father who takes on coaching a Little League baseball team in hopes to impress his boss, get a promotion, and be invited to an exclusive BBQ.

Looking for:
- Individuals to play businessmen. Must read as 30-50 years of age

Shooting Dates:
- October 3rd: 8 AM-6 PM
- October 4th: 8 AM-6 PM

Shooting Location: Loveland, CO

Businessmen are unpaid, but will receive IMDb credit. You must be ok with sitting around and waiting. Unfortunately, that’s the majority of what the businessmen will be doing.

If you are interested, or know anyone who is interested, please reach out to me with your availability and your headshot. You can message me here or email me @ elliot.m.harrington@gmail.com

Thank you!

PAID CASTING CALL — PAIRS OF KIDS, AGES 6–11

• Shoot length: Approximately 1 hour
• Pay: $200 per child
• Location and schedule: Flexible
• Timing: Must film before October 12

A parent or guardian for must be present during filming.

Interested parents or guardians, please send me a private message with both children’s ages, recent photos, your general location, and availability.

Production company: Mile High Films

**Compensation:** Actors will be compensated. Lead roles: $150/day. Minor roles: $50/day. Actors will also receive film credit, meals and crafty on set, footage for demo reels, and a digital copy of the final film.

**Audition Information:** Please send your headshot and resume to [levelupproduction2026@gmail.com](mailto:levelupproduction2026@gmail.com) . Include your desired role in this email. Sides will be provided after.  You will need to provide a self-tape for your desired role by October 21.

**See attached for Roles and more information.**

🎤 **INDYWIDUALNE LEKCJE ŚPIEWU | WARSZAWA**

📍 **Bielany / Młociny – blisko metra Młociny**
💻 Zajęcia **stacjonarnie lub online**

🌿 Więcej o mnie i o tym, jak pracuję, znajdziesz na: **singspiration.pl**

👉 Jeśli chcesz sprawdzić dostępne terminy, wejdź na stronę i kliknij **„Zapisz mnie”** – przejdziesz bezpośrednio do kalendarza, w którym możesz wybrać wolny termin.

🎬 **Drodzy statyści, epizodyści, przyszli aktorzy, hobbyści i pasjonaci aktorstwa!**

Statystowanie i pierwsze epizody mogą być świetnym sposobem, żeby poznać plan filmowy od środka, obserwować pracę aktorów i sprawdzić, czy jest to droga, którą chcemy rozwijać dalej.

Jeśli jednak czujesz, że chcesz zrobić **kolejny krok** – próbować swoich sił w castingach, przygotowywać się do szkoły aktorskiej, teatru, musicalu, dubbingu czy pracy z mikrofonem – warto zacząć świadomie budować swój warsztat.

🎭 **Jednym z podstawowych narzędzi aktora jest głos.**

Lekcje śpiewu nie zastąpią zajęć aktorskich, ale mogą być ich wartościowym uzupełnieniem. Podczas spotkań pracujemy m.in. nad:

• głosem i oddechem
• emocjami i interpretacją
• świadomością ciała i napięć
• ekspresją i obecnością sceniczną
• tremą i blokadami przed występowaniem
• większą swobodą w byciu słyszanym i widzianym

W swojej pracy łączę **4 obszary: EMOCJĘ • MYŚL • CIAŁO • GŁOS**.

Poznaj nas! Jesteśmy duetem twórczym. Działamy od wielu lat. Z zawodu Jesteśmy aktorami. Postanowiliśmy zbudować własną przestrzeń. W poszanowaniu dla granic. Bez przemocy i presji. 🎬 **CASTING CALL — FEMALE LEAD PUNJABI SPEAKING**
Volunteer Opportunity | SoulTales Creative

Seeking a South Asian actress with a playing age of 30–35 to play Avneet in our indie Punjabi short film, *Bhanji - Sabotage*.

Avneet is tired of dating but still hopeful about finding love. When someone she connects with suddenly goes quiet, her doubts resurface. The role calls for natural acting that captures vulnerability, hope and anxiety.

Prior acting or on-camera experience is strongly preferred. We’re looking for a committed performer who can dedicate time to character preparation before the shoot. This role is suited to someone who is comfortable acting and understands the preparation and rehearsal process. It is not suitable for someone exploring acting for the first time.

**Location:** Langley / Abbotsford, BC
**Shoot:** One day; Tentatively on a weekend in late October. Additional preparation time required.
**Compensation:** Volunteer / unpaid role

To apply, send your headshot, acting reel or performance clip, a brief summary of your experience, and availability to 📩 [soultales.ca@gmail.com](mailto:soultales.ca@gmail.com) Subject: Avneet for Bhanji - Sabotage Casting Or DM us [@soultales_creative](https://www.instagram.com/soultales_creative/) on Instagram

🚨 $40-$50/HR NEXT WEEK!!!
Branded Promo Talent, a leading experiential marketing agency, is seeking dependable, outgoing, and professional Event Managers and Brand Ambassadors for brand launch activations across five markets next week!

Dates, Times & Locations:
📍 Memphis, TN
Mon, Oct 5 → Tues, Oct 6, 2026
11:00 PM–7:00 AM

📍 Raleigh, NC
Mon, Oct 5 → Tues, Oct 6, 2026
10:00 PM–6:00 AM

📍 Cleveland, OH
Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
1:00 AM–7:00 AM

📍 Jacksonville, FL
Weds, Oct 7 → Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
10:00 PM–7:00 AM

📍 Kansas City, MO
Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
8:00 AM–4:00 PM

All times are onsite hours and include setup, activation, and breakdown for both roles.

Compensation:
• Event Managers: $50 per hour
• Brand Ambassadors: $40 per hour

— 1099, paid weekly —

Event Managers will receive additional paid hours for offsite pickups and returns.

Event Details:
Help introduce new products from a national food brand to employees, warehouse teams, and drivers before they reach the market. The activation will feature product sampling, food, refreshments, giveaways, and an onsite raffle.

Event Manager Duties:
• Coordinate logistics, lead the onsite team, and manage event flow.
• Pick up and return event supplies at Southwest Cargo near the airport.
• Collect Walmart orders containing food, refreshments, and event supplies.
• Transport equipment and lead team setup, breakdown, and loading.
• Oversee sampling, food and refreshments, giveaways, and raffle participation.
• Complete a recap report through Google Forms and upload event photos to Google Drive.

Event Manager Requirements:
• Must have a truck, SUV, or van capable of transporting a 10×10 tent, table, backdrop, banner, premiums, and supplies.
• Must be available for pickups and returns before and after the event.
• Must have prior Event Manager experience and strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
• Must lead by example, actively performing Brand Ambassador duties while guiding and supporting the team.

Brand Ambassador Duties:
• Assist with unloading, setup, breakdown, packing, and loading.
• Welcome employees and drivers and introduce products using approved messaging.
• Assist with product sampling, food, refreshments, and giveaways.
• Encourage raffle participation and explain entry instructions.
• Keep the activation clean and organized while supporting smooth guest flow.
• Support the Event Manager and represent the brand professionally.

Staff Expectations:
We are looking for punctual, dependable, and engaging staff who work well as a team. You must be comfortable assisting with setup and breakdown and working the full scheduled shift, including overnight hours where applicable.

Application Process:
To be considered, email chrissy@brandedpromotalent.com with the following:
• Market & Role
• Availability
• Resume
• Headshot
• Relevant experience
• A brief description of why you’re an excellent fit for this role
• Event Managers - confirm you have a truck, SUV, or van to transport assets.

Please use “Brand Launch — [City/Role]” as the subject of your email.

Note: Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered. Our team will review qualifications via email and schedule a call with eligible candidates.

items.text:
Hong Kong’s acclaimed film of the year, 《We’re Nothing At All（我們不是什麼）》will arrive in Los Angeles in October. Director Herman Yau (邱禮濤導演), along with lead actors AK (江𤒹生) from the Hong Kong group Mirror ，and Ansonbean (陳毅燊), will hold three screening and Q&A events in Los Angeles on October 7, 9, and 10. 

Everyone is welcome to register and purchase tickets to attend.

*Please check the official website of the organizer, Blacklight Global Entertainment, for ticket details:

https://www.blacklight-global.com

Official Instagram:

https://www.instagram.com/blacklightglobal.usa?stkn=MXQ3cXZiazV2MWNuaw==

———————————

You are welcome to register and purchase tickets to participate.

 • October 7 at USC – Free registration：

https://cinema.usc.edu/events/event.cfm?id=73397

 • October 9 at UCLA – Free registration：

https://www.international.ucla.edu/ccs/event/17766

——————————

 • October 10 public screening at The Culver Theater – Tickets available for purchase：

https://web.theculvertheater.com/films/Were-Nothing-At-All/HO00000747

——————————————

Media inquiries: 

info@blacklight-global.com

Hong Kong’s acclaimed film of the year, 《We’re Nothing At All（我們不是什麼）》will arrive in Los Angeles in October. Director Herman Yau (邱禮濤導演), along with lead actors AK (江𤒹生) from the Hong Kong group Mirror ，and Ansonbean (陳毅燊), will hold three screening and Q&A events in Los Angeles on October 7, 9, and 10. 

Everyone is welcome to register and purchase tickets to attend.

*Please check the official website of the organizer, Blacklight Global Entertainment, for ticket details:

https://www.blacklight-global.com

Official Instagram:

https://www.instagram.com/blacklightglobal.usa?stkn=MXQ3cXZiazV2MWNuaw==

———————————

You are welcome to register and purchase tickets to participate.

 • October 7 at USC – Free registration：

https://cinema.usc.edu/events/event.cfm?id=73397

 • October 9 at UCLA – Free registration：

https://www.international.ucla.edu/ccs/event/17766

——————————

 • October 10 public screening at The Culver Theater – Tickets available for purchase：

https://web.theculvertheater.com/films/Were-Nothing-At-All/HO00000747

info@blacklight-global.com

Casting Call for a Short Film
Hi everyone! We are casting for an independent short film shooting in📍Bucharest, Romania in early November.

Genre: Psychological Drama / Crime Comedy

📃Synopsis:

The film follows two brothers who travel to Romania believing they are about to inherit a fortune from their supposedly dying aunt. A series of misunderstandings and increasingly disastrous decisions turns their inheritance trip into a chaotic night on the run.

🎭 JOE

Gender: male

Playing ages: 20–30

Language: English with a UK accent 

Flamboyant, confident, funny and highly verbal. Joe is intelligent and successful, but underneath his confidence is an emotionally immature younger brother who desperately wants his older brother’s approval.

He uses humour as a defence mechanism, becoming more sarcastic, energetic and ridiculous when uncomfortable or afraid.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Improvisational instincts

• Strong screen presence

• Comfortable with fast dialogue & profanity

• Ability to shift naturally between comedy, arrogance, fear and vulnerability

🎭 AUNTIE VIOLET

Gender: female

Playing ages: 65-75

Language: English with a UK accent 

A key supporting role with relatively short screen time, but an important presence in the film. 

Violet initially appears to be a wealthy, eccentric elderly woman whom the brothers believe is dying. 

She is glamorous, sharp, mischievous and intimidating, with a strong sense of control and authority.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Confident, commanding presence

• Ability to convey glamour and authority

• Ability to play sudden, realistic death

• Comfortable with profanity

Note: The final head-explosion effect will be created using a dummy/prosthetic. The actress will not be in danger.

▪️Audition: Self-tape

▪️This is an unpaid role. However, all expenses related to the project will be covered, including meals, travel. 

📩 To apply: send your headshot + CV to cinedanny88@gmail.com

Please include “JOE” or “AUNTIE VIOLET” in the subject line.

📢 Feel free to share this casting call with anyone you think might be a good fit for either role. Thank you!

items.text:
We have a SHELL job we are casting for specifically on Thursday, 8th October 2026

Please see roles below:

JHB Asian Mom
JHB Asian Leo
JHB Asian Dad

Please have a close look at role descriptions, JHB Talent will need to self tape but if you have talent in CPT please state this under provisions and we will invite to studio.                                               
JHB Asian Mum
Description
__________________________
30- 40 yrs

Mum is the kind of parent who quietly helps fuel Leos imagination.
She gives him the freedom to explore, create and get lost in his own world, while always being there with warmth, encouragement and a playful spirit.
She has a natural way of making everyday moments feel special and brings a genuine sense of joy and creativity into Leos life.

Mum is a grounding force that brings a sense of warmth and comfort.

In casting, we need to get a sense of how our parents interact with children.
You can spot right away if the performer has that mum or dad energy with how they play, and how they redirect the kids on their own.
Gender
Female
Playing Age
30 to 40 years
Appearance
Asian
Rate
R10,000 day fee
View And Respond To This Role
JHB Asian Dad
Description
__________________________
30-40 yrs

Dad is the kind of parent who turns simple drives with Leo into something they both look forward to, whether it is heading out to a forested road or just around the
neighbourhood.

Their adventures often begin with a stop at a Shell forecourt, and Dad has quietly noticed how much Leo has absorbed from those moments, especially the Click. Shtick. Vroom. ritual he has created from the familiar sounds of filling up.

He has a calm, grounding presence that gives Leo the freedom to let his imagination run wild,
while still being right there with him, ready to tap into the kid in himself and share in the joy of the moment.
Dad shares his love of cars and always supports Leos curiosity and imagination.

PAID UK-WIDE ENTERTAINMENT OPPORTUNITIES

Epic Moments UK is currently looking to connect with adult performers with dwarfism who may be interested in paid entertainment work across the UK.

Bookings can include:
• Corporate events
• Private parties
• Themed character appearances
• Meet & greets
• Promotional work
• Party entertainment

We understand this type of work won’t be for everyone and there is absolutely no pressure to accept anything you’re not comfortable with. Performers can choose which types of bookings they wish to take on.

Seeking a male actor for the Photographer.

Preferred playing age: 24–32.

During a portrait session, a photographer and his subject stumble into moments of accidental intimacy. A playful stolen-glasses gag turns their awkward attraction into an intentional connection.

This is a no-dialogue role built around expressive physical acting, comic timing, subtle reactions, and chemistry with the female lead. Blocking will be rehearsed, with room for controlled improvisation.

Shoot dates: November 7–8, 2026
Location: CCA studio, Denver/Aurora area
Commitment: Up to eight hours each shoot day, plus a separate rehearsal scheduled by mutual availability.

Unpaid student production. Lunch and craft services provided.

Director / DP: Jim Burnes
Casting Director / Rehearsal Lead: Mitch Marquez

If interested, please message Jim Burnes with a headshot, reel or recent audition clip if available, and your availability for both shoot days and rehearsal. Script available upon request.

🎬 CASTING DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO

Role bez tekstu.

Zgłoszenia tylko drogą mailową

Poszukujemy aktorów/epizodystów:

Mężczyzna — 20-25 lat

Młody, atrakcyjny mężczyzna. Szczupła, proporcjonalna sylwetka.
Typ: miejski, nowoczesny, premium / corporate.
Zadbany, pewny siebie, ambitny.

Kobieta — 18-20 lat

Młoda kobieta o charakterystycznej, naturalnej urodzie i wyrazistej twarzy. Długie ciemne włosy, szczupła sylwetka.
Typ: niezależna, współczesna, z charakterem.
Mile widziana naturalna, nieoczywista uroda i mocna osobowość.

Mężczyzna — 75-85 lat

Senior o bardzo charakterystycznej twarzy, siwych włosach i zaroście. Szczupła lub średnia sylwetka.
Szukamy osoby ciepłej, wiarygodnej i emocjonalnej, potrafiącej opowiadać historię przede wszystkim spojrzeniem i mimiką.
Naturalność i autentyczność mile widziane.

Mężczyzna — 30–40 lat

Przystojny, charakterystyczny mężczyzna o wyrazistych rysach i ciemnych włosach.
Postać pojawia się w kilku okresach: lata 60,70 i 80, dlatego ważna jest możliwość wiarygodnego pokazania upływu czasu.
Typ: charyzmatyczny, męski, ekranowy.

Kobieta — 30–40 lat

Kobieta o ciepłej, klasycznej urodzie.
Kobieca, elegancka, naturalna.
Postać również pokazujemy w różnych okresach – lata 60., 70. i 80.
Ważna umiejętność wiarygodnego przechodzenia między różnymi etapami życia i stylami epoki.

Kobieta — 40–55 lat

Ciepła, zadbana, atrakcyjna kobieta o naturalnym wyglądzie.
Typ: współczesna mama – silna, troskliwa, rodzinna.
Naturalna mimika i wiarygodność przed kamerą ważniejsze niż „modelowy” wygląd.

Mężczyzna — 45–55 lat

Zadbany, męski, naturalny mężczyzna. Krótkie ciemne włosy, możliwy lekki zarost.
Typ: spokojny, pracowity, rodzinny tata.
Szukamy naturalności, ciepła i wiarygodności, bez przesadnie „reklamowego” wizerunku.

📍 Zdjęcia w Warszawie w 2 połowie października

blackwolfproductionpl@gmail.com

📝 W treści zgłoszenia podaj:
• Imię i nazwisko
• Wiek
• Numer telefonu
• Zdjęcie twarzy i całej sylwetki
• Demo/real (link do YouTube)

HALLOWEEN SCARE MAZE EXPERIENCE 👻    - 🎃 ACTORS WANTED!
📍 Tintwistle, Derbyshire | 30th & 31st October 2026

⭐ Great opportunity to gain live performance experience & add to your acting CV

We're looking for actors/performers to join us for our Halloween scare maze on Friday 30th and Saturday 31st October, taking place in Tintwistle, Derbyshire.

We've been running our scare experience as a family-run event for around 8 years, and every year we continue to make it bigger and better. What started out much smaller has grown into a production with detailed sets, animatronics, props, lighting, sound, strobe effects, special effects and a large cast of actors.

This year we're looking to build an even bigger cast and are looking for people who would love the chance to get involved in a proper live, immersive performance environment.

🎭 What could you be doing?

• Playing a dedicated character within the attraction

• Performing jump scares and character interactions

• Working within themed rooms and sets

• Improvising and interacting with members of the public

• Working alongside other actors to create scares

• Potentially having a character, room or jump scare specifically designed around you

This is an unpaid opportunity, and a free event with donations going towards North West Air Ambulance Charity. ❤️🚁

However, this could be a great opportunity for actors and performers looking to gain practical live performance experience, build their CV and get experience performing for a live audience in an immersive environment.

You don't need professional acting experience to get involved. We're mainly looking for people who are enthusiastic, confident, creative and willing to throw themselves into a character and have some fun with it!

👻 The earlier you get involved, the more we can create around you!

Once we know who is joining the cast, we can start planning characters, costumes, makeup, rooms and individual scares.

If we know you're coming early enough, we can potentially build a room around your character, design a jump scare specifically for you, create props for your scene and develop your character within the attraction.

So the sooner we can get our cast confirmed, the more time we have to make your part of the experience really good.

📅 Friday 30th October (6-10pm)

📅 Sat 31st October (6-10pm)

📍 Tintwistle, Derbyshire

❤️ In aid of North West Air Ambulance Charity

If you're interested, please comment below or send me a DM with a little bit about yourself, any acting/performance experience you have (if any), and which date(s) you're available for

.

We're hoping to put together a really strong cast and a massive Halloween experience this year, so if this sounds like something you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you! 🎃👻

Feel free to tag any actors/performers who might be interested!

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, dein Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 41/2026

MUSICAL TIME IM WEINVIERTEL,  EINE VERGESSENE INSEL UND DIE AUSTRIAN KINO CHARTS 

Der neueste Universal Animationshit führt uns auf die FORGOTTEN ISLAND. Ein Roboter unterstützt den Alltag von FRAU WINKLER VERLÄSST DAS HAUS.

Gleich 2 Musicalevents starten dieser Tage. In Wolkersdorf kommt die Hippie Zeit mit HAIR zurück und in Klosterneuburg erlebt die Trapp Familie den SOUND OF MUSIC. Moderatorin Sarah Fuchs konnte mit Protagonisten dieser Events jeweils ein Interview führen.

Neben den österreichischen Kinocharts gibts wie immer die beste Musik aus den besten Filmen aller Zeiten.

Mittwoch 7.10.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

Casting Call for a Short Film
Hi everyone! We are casting for an independent short film shooting in📍Bucharest, Romania in early November.

Genre: Psychological Drama / Crime Comedy

📃Synopsis:

The film follows two brothers who travel to Romania believing they are about to inherit a fortune from their supposedly dying aunt. A series of misunderstandings and increasingly disastrous decisions turns their inheritance trip into a chaotic night on the run.

🎭 JOE

Gender: male

Playing ages: 20–30

Language: English with a UK accent 

Flamboyant, confident, funny and highly verbal. Joe is intelligent and successful, but underneath his confidence is an emotionally immature younger brother who desperately wants his older brother’s approval.

He uses humour as a defence mechanism, becoming more sarcastic, energetic and ridiculous when uncomfortable or afraid.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Improvisational instincts

• Strong screen presence

• Comfortable with fast dialogue & profanity

• Ability to shift naturally between comedy, arrogance, fear and vulnerability

🎭 AUNTIE VIOLET

Gender: female

Playing ages: 65-75

Language: English with a UK accent 

A key supporting role with relatively short screen time, but an important presence in the film. 

Violet initially appears to be a wealthy, eccentric elderly woman whom the brothers believe is dying. 

She is glamorous, sharp, mischievous and intimidating, with a strong sense of control and authority.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Confident, commanding presence

• Ability to convey glamour and authority

• Ability to play sudden, realistic death

• Comfortable with profanity

Note: The final head-explosion effect will be created using a dummy/prosthetic. The actress will not be in danger.

▪️Audition: Self-tape

▪️This is an unpaid role. However, all expenses related to the project will be covered, including meals, travel. 

📩 To apply: send your headshot + CV to cinedanny88@gmail.com

Please include “JOE” or “AUNTIE VIOLET” in the subject line.

📢 Feel free to share this casting call with anyone you think might be a good fit for either role. Thank you!

CASTING CALL — FEATURE FILM | SHOOTING IN CHINA
Filming planned to start November 2026.

Looking for Pan-Asian actors currently based outside China. International flights to China are covered by production as well as all other costs .MUST SPEAK CHINESE. Payment negotiable.

We are especially looking for TALENT AGENTS / AGENCIES who can provide suitable options. Agent commissions are available.

ROLES

* Zhou Yanyang — Male, 18–22 | 19 shooting days

    Student. Wears glasses. Intelligent appearance, but timid, insecure and jealous.

* Jan Bequelin — Male, 18–22 | 32 shooting days

    Student. Aggressive, unpleasant personality; a bully who intimidates weaker people.

* Chen Jia Yi — Female, 18–22 | 18 shooting days

    Student. Wild, outgoing, comfortable around boys; vain and eager to escape her fishing-village background.

* Avin — Male, 30–40 | 9 shooting days

    Local fixer/troublemaker. Flexible, impulsive and strongly motivated by money.

* Old Quarter — Male, 50–60 | 6 shooting days

    School security guard. Street-smart, slick and prone to bullying outsiders.

* Huang Yan — Female, 40–50 | 15 shooting days

    Fisherwoman and mother. Quiet, hardworking and superstitious; initially timid but capable of great courage when protecting her daughter.

The project is a Chinese theatrical feature combining folk-horror and mystery elements. 电影《鱼猎》项目书.pdf

TO APPLY: Send photos + acting CV + acting/showreel video +  to kustom1234@hotmail.com or via Messenger.

AGENTS: Please send multiple suitable talent options. Commission available if chosen

Er du ægte Annika fan? Så er det måske lige noget for dig 👀

Vi er i gang med at caste til et nyt sjovt koncept, hvor 6 ægte Annika fans skal dyste mod 1 bedrager, som skal forsøge at bluffe sig til at være fan af Annika.

Gennem forskellige runder skal I snakke om Annika, hendes musik, sange, koncerter og jeres oplevelser som fans, mens I samtidig skal prøve at gennemskue, hvem der ikke er den ægte fan.

Det foregår i København NV, og der er 1.000 kr. på spil. Hvis bedrageren bliver afsløret, deler de ægte fans præmien. Hvis bedrageren slipper igennem, vinder personen hele beløbet.

Kender du en ægte Annika fan, som kunne være med? Så tag gerne personen her eller send opslaget videre.

**Håndmodel søges til lønnede Arla-optagelser den 7. og 8. oktober**

På vegne af Arla, The Barn, søger jeg en håndmodel til vores kommende optagelser. Vi søger en person med hænder og kropsbygning, der ligner personen på de vedhæftede referencebilleder - gerne med en let solbrun hudtone og uden synlige tatoveringer på hænder, arme og overkrop.

Optagelserne foregår i Viby J, Aarhus, og det er en fordel, hvis du bor i Aarhus eller omegn. På optagelserne vil du være iført sportstøj, og kun hænder og overkrop vil være synlige, uden ansigt eller andre genkendelige kendetegn. Jobbet er lønnet, og vi ønsker en aftale med total buyout af rettighederne til materialet.

Er du interesseret og tilgængelig på de nævnte datoer, så send mig gerne en mail med billeder af dine hænder og dig selv samt en kort beskrivelse af dig.

Mail: [ext_cecch@arlafoods.com](mailto:ext_cecch@arlafoods.com)
Bemærk, at vi kun kontakter de kandidater, der matcher det, vi søger.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!
